rounds.text: Catvision Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its underlying asset value, with a price-to-book ratio of 0.50x compared to a sector benchmark of 1.54x [E2, E7]. This valuation gap is underscored by a compelling 9.81% dividend yield, which rewards shareholders while the market undervalues the firm's equity [E4]. The company has reached a critical inflection point, as evidenced by a 175% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months and a 40% growth rate over the past three years [E20, E21]. This momentum is further validated by the scanX signal engine, which notes that profit growth is now significantly outpacing price growth, suggesting the market has yet to fully price in this operational turnaround [E57]. Conceded: the company has struggled with long-term sales and profit contraction, as shown by the 10-year compounded sales growth of -8% and profit growth of -22% [E14, E18]. However, the recent 11% growth in sales and 12% year-over-year increase indicate that the business is successfully reversing these historical trends [E17, E67].
